entries.name: Warden Banner
entries.description: A banner hung for the first hall you emptied.

entries.name: Banner Row
entries.description: One banner for each hall that answered you.

entries.name: Trophy Hall
entries.description: What is left of the wardens, mounted where the light reaches it.

entries.name: Deep Road Marker
entries.description: A stone cut with the depth you reached and barely returned from.

entries.name: Archive Shelves
entries.description: The pages you filled had to go somewhere.

entries.name: The Full Archive
entries.description: Every quarry named, drawn and closed.

entries.name: Workshop Annex
entries.description: A second bench, and someone to stand at it.

entries.name: Notice Board
entries.description: People trust the tower enough to pin work to it.

entries.name: Descent Shrine
entries.description: Tokens left by everyone who went down and chose to come back.

entries.name: Record Stone
entries.description: Twenty runs cut into one slab, in the order you survived them.
